description: Java entity class representing a product review in an e-commerce system, including fields for review details, relationships to customer and product, and audit information.

classes.name: ProductReview
classes.description: Entity class for product reviews, encapsulating review data, associations to customer and product, and audit information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the product review.

methods.name: getReviewRead
methods.description: Retrieves the number of reads for this review.

methods.name: setReviewRead
methods.description: Sets the number of reads for this review.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of the review.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the review.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer who made the review.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a customer with this review.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with this review.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of review descriptions.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Gets the date the review was submitted.
